verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents a free trial that grants access to all Professional plan features before subscribing, so a founder can integrate and evaluate the service. However, the evidence never states that the trial permits real deliveries to arbitrary recipients, nor what its volume, duration or recipient limits are. One community report of an account being denied without explanation adds some uncertainty about onboarding, but it does not concretely contradict the trial claim. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that trial or free sending reaches real external recipients, documented trial or free-tier limits (volume, duration, domain verification), and independent hands-on corroboration of production sends during the trial.

support.subject: As a founder, I can integrate and validate the service on a free tier or trial that allows real deliveries to my own users, not just a demo

citations.quote: Start your free trial and get access to all Professional plan features, then subscribe to a plan when you’re ready.
